reasoning: Round 1 bought no tissue: all controls, saturated or dead. The wk_ family is not in the legal set anymore; the type system now offers structural edits on two growth-capable spines. Anchor the Okuda coupling route (parent 2) and the round-33 forced recipe (parent 1) as controls, then knock out one operator at a time to learn which carries tubulation. Two adds probe whether extra uniform inflation amplifies or washes out the pattern. Nothing here saturated the array before.

slots.claim: Okuda coupling route (patterning + growth + division + T1) reproduces tubulation/undulation, unchanged
slots.why: control and Track-B reproduction target: the full coupled monolayer is Okuda's tubulation recipe

slots.claim: removing morphogen diffusion kills the Turing prepattern, so growth is uniform and no tubes form
slots.why: coupling (chi) needs a patterned field; without diffusion no spatial gradient can localize a tube

slots.claim: removing patterned growth leaves mechanics-only, collapsing to the sphere null
slots.why: growth is the presumed driver of protrusion; its removal should return the rigid-ball null

slots.claim: without T1 reconnection the sheet cannot remodel topology, so tubes cannot elongate or branch
slots.why: tests whether topological remodeling is necessary for the Okuda morphology or merely cosmetic

slots.claim: growth without cell division still bulges into a protrusion
slots.why: genuinely uncertain: does area growth alone deform the sheet, or is division required to add cells into the tube

slots.claim: removing the cell-geometry operator degrades the force integration and suppresses protrusion
slots.why: maps whether cell_geometry_3d is load-bearing for deformation in the coupled route

slots.claim: superimposing uniform inflation on the patterned route inflates the whole vesicle and amplifies peak protrusion
slots.why: combination Okuda never tried: does uniform pressure add to or wash out the patterned tube

slots.claim: the round-33 driven+forced recipe reproduces a forced thick tube (mech_p_ratio ~3)
slots.why: second control/Track-B anchor: a distinct forced-protrusion recipe, unmeasured soundly, anchors the parent-1 knockouts

slots.claim: removing patterned growth from the forced recipe drops it to mechanics-only, no protrusion
slots.why: isolates whether growth or the forcing carries the parent-1 protrusion

slots.claim: without T1 the forced recipe cannot form a discrete tube
slots.why: cross-checks the T1 necessity claim on a second, forced spine

slots.claim: removing neighbor tracking breaks the mechanical coupling and reduces peak protrusion
slots.why: maps whether cell_adjacency is necessary for coherent force transmission in the forced recipe

slots.claim: adding uniform inflation to the already-forced recipe raises peak protrusion further
slots.why: extremum: stacks two protrusion drivers to test whether the forcing saturates or adds
